definition_en: having the colour of earth or wood
core_image: 秋天铺满小路的褐色落叶
scene: 秋风一过，树上的叶子落了满地。The brown leaves lay along the path.
sceneCN: 这里 brown 是「褐色的」（第 1 个义项：像泥土或木头的颜色）；句意是褐色的落叶铺在小路上。

senses.title: The colour of earth
senses.definition: having the colour of soil, wood or coffee
senses.definitionCN: 具有泥土、木头或咖啡那样的颜色
senses.example: The brown leaves lay along the path.
senses.exampleCN: 褐色的落叶铺在小路上。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, naming a colour between red and yellow.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，指介于红与黄之间的一种颜色。

senses.title: Tanned by the sun
senses.definition: having skin darkened by the sun
senses.definitionCN: 皮肤被太阳晒深了颜色
senses.example: He came back from the coast brown and rested.
senses.exampleCN: 他从海边回来，晒得皮肤黝黑，精神很好。
senses.why: Sun-darkened skin takes on the colour of earth.
senses.whyCN: 被太阳晒深的皮肤呈现出泥土般的颜色。

senses.title: To cook until golden
senses.definition: to cook meat or onions until they turn brown
senses.definitionCN: 把肉或洋葱煎到变成褐色
senses.example: Brown the onions before adding the rice.
senses.exampleCN: 加米之前先把洋葱煎至焦黄。
senses.why: The verb simply names the colour the food reaches.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词就取名于食物达到的那种颜色。

definition_en: a tool with short stiff hairs for cleaning or painting

scene: 出门前她站在镜子前。She brushed her hair before breakfast.
sceneCN: 这里 brush 是「刷」（第 2 个义项：用刷子梳理或清洁）；句意是早饭前她梳了头发。

senses.title: A tool with stiff hairs
senses.definition: a tool with short stiff hairs on a handle
senses.definitionCN: 带柄、装有短而硬的毛的工具

senses.exampleCN: 他用一把硬毛刷清理靴子。

definition_en: a ball of air or gas inside a liquid
core_image: 肥皂泡在阳光下透出彩虹色
scene: 厨房里水壶刚刚烧开。Soap bubbles rose from the warm water.
sceneCN: 这里 bubble 是「气泡」（第 1 个义项：液体中包着空气的小球）；句意是温水中升起一串肥皂泡。

senses.title: A ball of air in liquid
senses.definition: a small ball of air or gas inside a liquid
senses.definitionCN: 液体中包着空气或气体的小球
senses.example: Soap bubbles rose from the warm water.
senses.exampleCN: 温水中升起一串肥皂泡。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, named after the sound of boiling.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，名字来自沸腾时的声音。

senses.title: To form bubbles
senses.definition: to produce bubbles as a liquid heats or moves
senses.definitionCN: 液体受热或流动时不断产生气泡
senses.example: The soup was bubbling in the pot.
senses.exampleCN: 锅里的汤正在冒泡。
senses.why: The noun became a verb describing the same rising motion.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化成动词，描述同一种上涌的动作。

senses.title: An economic bubble
senses.definition: a period when prices rise far above real value
senses.definitionCN: 价格远超真实价值的一段时期
senses.example: The housing bubble burst that winter.
senses.exampleCN: 那年冬天房地产泡沫破裂了。
senses.why: A bubble looks solid but holds only air, like prices without value.
senses.whyCN: 气泡看似实在，里面却只有空气，正如没有价值支撑的价格。

senses.title: A male deer

senses.example: A buck raised its head at the edge of the trees.

definition_en: a heavy load that is hard to carry
core_image: 山路上背着柴捆弯着腰的人
scene: 山路很陡，柴捆压得他弯着腰。The load was a heavy burden on his back.
sceneCN: 这里 burden 是「重担」（第 1 个义项：沉重难负的实物负荷）；句意是那捆柴是他背上的重担。

derivatives.zh: 繁重的，令人负担沉重的

senses.title: A heavy physical load
senses.definition: a load that is heavy to carry

senses.example: The load was a heavy burden on his back.

root: burst 源自古英语 berstan，本义为「突然裂开」；十六世纪起用于情绪冲出，如 burst into tears；十九世纪起作名词，指声音、动作或情绪的一阵爆发。

sensesIntro.en: A pipe splitting, feeling escaping, and one short outbreak.

definition_en: to put a dead body into the ground
core_image: 土坑旁堆起的一座新坟
scene: 狗在院子角落刨个不停。The dog buried the bone in the garden.
sceneCN: 这里 bury 是「掩埋」（第 2 个义项：把东西埋进土里）；句意是狗把骨头埋在院子里。

collocations.phrase: bury one's face in one's hands

senses.title: To place a body in the ground
senses.definition: to put a dead person or animal into the earth
senses.definitionCN: 把死去的或动物放入土中
senses.example: They buried him beside the old church.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把他葬在旧教堂旁。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, tied to funeral custom.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，与丧葬习俗相关。

senses.title: To cover with earth
senses.definition: to cover something with soil or another material
senses.definitionCN: 用土或其他材料把东西盖住
senses.example: The dog buried the bone in the garden.
senses.exampleCN: 狗把骨头埋在院子里。
senses.why: Covering a body and covering an object share one motion.
senses.whyCN: 掩埋遗体与埋藏物件，是同一个动作。

senses.title: To hide or devote oneself
senses.definition: to hide something, or to give all your attention to it
senses.definitionCN: 把某物藏起来，或把全部注意力投进去
senses.example: He buried himself in his books.
senses.exampleCN: 他埋头读书。
senses.why: What is buried is out of sight, like a person lost in work.
senses.whyCN: 被埋起来的东西看不见，正如埋头工作的人。

intro.en: Bury is an old Germanic word for placing something in the earth.
intro.cn: bury 是古老的日耳曼词，意为把东西放进土里。

items.en: byrgan meant to bury a body.
items.cn: byrgan 意为埋葬遗体。

items.en: bury extended to hiding objects in the ground.
items.cn: bury 扩展到把物品埋进土里。

items.en: Burial named the funeral ceremony.
items.cn: burial 指葬礼仪式。

items.en: Burying oneself in study meant total attention.
items.cn: bury oneself in study 指全心投入。

items.en: bury covers funerals, hidden things and deep attention.
items.cn: 如今 bury 涵盖葬礼、埋藏与专注。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the b- and -rry shape; the near-meaning group gives interment words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 b- 与 -rry 的外形；近义组是埋葬类的词。

normalIntro.en: Bury is putting something under the ground and out of sight.
normalIntro.cn: bury 就是把东西放到地下、看不见的地方。

normal.en: Dogs bury bones to save them.
normal.cn: 狗埋骨头是为了存起来。

normal.en: The past tense is buried.
A burial is the ceremony of burying.
Buried in work means very busy.
normal.cn: buried in work 指忙得不可开交。

normal.en: Bury the past and move on.
normal.cn: 把往事埋起来，继续往前走。

sensesIntro.en: A funeral in the earth, an object under soil, and attention hidden in work.
